t: Pack of 2 Forge Steel 115mm manhole cover keys offers a robust solution for safely lifting drainage and utility covers. Essential for plumbers, groundworkers, and general maintenance professionals, the heavy duty lifting keys provide reliable access to underground systems. Constructed from durable carbon steel, each key features a 115mm handle and d-shaped ends that secure firmly into manhole lifting eyes, ensuring a strong grip and safe removal of covers up to 50kg. The short, T-shape design enhances control during operation, making them an indispensable tool for site work.
b: D-Shaped Ends For Secure Lifting & Grip
